fixtureOptions: Public static Lit declarations use noAccessor:true, reflect:true and useDefault:true where appropriate. Existing atomState implementation and dependency patch imported unchanged.
findings: 10/12 targeted public-integration checks passed in both happy-dom and Chromium.
Initial defaults unexpectedly reflect to attributes in this composition.
Writing a shared atom externally updates getter/derived rendering but not the reflected attribute or named changedProperties.
sourceExplanation: atomState creates an accessor recognized as wrapped by Lit; its constructor-time named notification can schedule reflection before wrapped-default capture completes.
Property setter writes call requestUpdate(name,old); external atom writes only reach upstream selector's unnamed requestUpdate().
limitations: Not a full public-property contract test
No Firefox/WebKit, screen-reader, compiler, CEM or React execution
No exhaustive inheritance, upgrade timing, converters or equality matrix

latestPackageCheck.method: Integrity-verified npm archive; complete index, selector and atom source read without install
latestPackageCheck.finding: Adds selector.value; still supplies rendering notification without named-property reflection and no hostConnected hook in inspected selector. Upgrade alone does not establish resolution.

next: Record a feasible refinement of the existing helper, carry authoring/toolchain and cross-browser gates into final shared-module acceptance, and continue native-form mechanism evaluation.

refinement.status: Scratch feasibility candidate; production source unchanged; not a final universal helper
changes: Keep atomState accessors and official TanStackStoreAtom. Add lifecycle-managed named notifications for external writes and reconciliation on connection.
Register ordinary @property({noAccessor:true,...}) metadata before atomState installs the prototype accessor. Preserve Lit default capture without private Lit fields.
Capture the shared atom initial value through a named public Lit requestUpdate before consumer writes.

regression.method: Copies of existing atom-state and store-reconnect tests in scratch; helper import redirected to candidate only.

typecheck.initialFailure: Overloaded TanStack set rejected union forwarding; corrected with explicit runtime function/value branch, no suppression.

refinement.comparison: Changing declarations alone passes 19/24 checks; it fixes local defaults but leaves shared default capture and external/reconnect notifications incomplete. Refined helper plus declarations passes 24/24 in happy-dom and Chromium.
remaining: Decorator-order sensitivity needs an enforced authoring contract or a better supported composition before migration.
The candidate keeps official render subscription plus a named-notification subscription; subscription cost and teardown need evaluation before universal adoption.
Firefox/WebKit, CEM output, compiler pipeline and React wrapper execution remain unverified.
No exhaustive inheritance, converters, hasChanged or stress/leak coverage is claimed.
